title: Motif 3: 314B Parameters, 13.2B Awake
hook: A 314B-parameter MoE that only lights up 13.2B per token, built on 384 experts per layer and a hybrid attention scheme that folds differential attention into compressed KV.
key_points: Decoder-only Mixture-of-Experts: 314B total parameters, 13.2B activated per token, 384 routed experts per sparse layer with 8 selected.
Fine-grained sparsity is the design bet — lots of expert capacity, small compute bill per token.
Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA) combines grouped differential attention with Multi-head Latent Attention's compressed key-value representation.
Adds manifold-constrained hyper-connections, Expert-Specific PolyNorm activations, and multi-token prediction for stability and inference speed.
Pretrained on ~12.5T tokens; selective MXFP8 compute, fused kernels, and window-aware context parallelism enable 256K-token training contexts.
Post-training uses six RL specialist teachers plus a supervised SWE teacher, merged via Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation.
content_html: Motif 3 is a decoder-only Mixture-of-Experts model whose numbers tell the whole architectural story: 314 billion total parameters, 13.2 billion activated per token, and 384 routed experts per sparse layer with eight selected. That's fine-grained sparsity taken seriously — enormous expert capacity, a modest compute bill on each forward pass.
extra_html:
Attention is the other bet. Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA) fuses grouped differential attention with the compressed key-value representation of Multi-head Latent Attention, and the stack adds modified manifold-constrained hyper-connections, Expert-Specific PolyNorm activations, and multi-token prediction to keep optimization stable and inference quick.

Pretraining ran over roughly 12.5 trillion tokens of web, STEM, code, math, multilingual and domain corpora, with selective MXFP8 compute and communication, memory-efficient fused kernels, and window-aware context parallelism carrying training out to 256K-token contexts. Post-training is where the specialist skills get merged: general supervised fine-tuning, then six RL-trained specialist teachers and one supervised software-engineering teacher folded together by Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation. The authors report competitive results against leading open-weight models, with particular strength on long-horizon agentic tasks and hallucination-sensitive evaluation. Lim et al., August 2026.

related.title: What Is a Mixture of Experts?
related.hook: Instead of running every input through one big network, route each token to a few specialist sub-networks - total capacity grows without proportional compute.

related.title: Grouped Query Experts: MoE Inside Attention
related.hook: Mixture-of-experts usually routes whole feed-forward layers. Grouped Query Experts routes attention query heads instead — matching a dense baseline while firing half of them per token.
